input.quote: Such audit shall not occur more than [***] in a given Calendar Year, unless for cause, and shall not concern books and records relating to a period more than [***] preceding the current Calendar Year.
input.rationale: Section 9.9 lets each Party (including RevMed as against Sanofi) audit the other's financial books and records, so the rule is engaged notwithstanding mutuality. The clause fails the fallback on material terms: the frequency cap is blank ([***] per Calendar Year) and is subject to an open-ended for-cause exception, so there is no effective once-per-year limit; the notice floor is blank ([***] prior notice); and the cost-shift trigger is blank ([***] percent underpayment), leaving the auditing Party's cost obligation unquantified. We fixed those three fallback parameters reciprocally with minimal edits. Two preferred points are already met and untouched: an independent auditor of international prominence (9.9(a)) who must sign a confidentiality agreement with the audited Party (9.9(d)). Business hours, off-site conduct and an express no-systems-access line are preferred-only and not pressed, since the audit reaches only books and records maintained under Section 9.8. Section 5.8 record review and Section 6.9 (Sanofi auditing RevMed) are not usage audits against us and are not flagged.

proposal.summary: Fix audit frequency at once per Calendar Year, 15 days' notice, and a 10% underpayment cost-shift threshold
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We set the audit parameters at our fallback position: one audit per Calendar Year (deleting the open-ended for-cause exception that removes any frequency cap), at least fifteen days' prior notice, and cost-shifting only where the underpayment exceeds ten percent. The limits remain reciprocal.

ops.oldText: but in any event at least [***] prior notice
ops.newText: but in any event at least fifteen (15) days' prior notice

ops.oldText: Such audit shall not occur more than [***] in a given Calendar Year, unless for cause,
ops.newText: Such audit shall not occur more than once in a given Calendar Year,

ops.oldText: which underpayment was more than [***] percent
ops.newText: which underpayment was more than ten percent (10%)

mappings.element: Vendor may audit no more than once per year.
Vendor must give at least 15 days' notice of an audit.
Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 10 percent.
